number of accounts on each plan.sql: SELECT p.name AS "plan", count(a.id)::int AS "accounts" FROM plans p JOIN accounts a ON a.plan_id = p.id GROUP BY p.id, p.name

total paid invoice revenue in cents per.sql: SELECT to_char(date_trunc('month', issued_at), 'YYYY-MM') AS "month", sum(amount_cents)::int AS "revenueCents" FROM invoices WHERE status = 'paid' AND issued_at >= $1::timestamptz GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

top N accounts by total paid invoice amo.sql: SELECT a.name AS "name", sum(i.amount_cents)::int AS "totalPaidCents" FROM accounts a JOIN invoices i ON i.account_id = a.id AND i.status = 'paid' GROUP BY a.id, a.name ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT $1::int

accounts with failed invoices since a da.sql: SELECT a.name AS "name", count(*)::int AS "failedInvoices" FROM accounts a JOIN invoices i ON i.account_id = a.id WHERE i.status = 'failed' AND i.issued_at >= $1::timestamptz GROUP BY a.id, a.name

plans that have accounts in a given coun.sql: SELECT p.name AS plan, a.name FROM accounts a JOIN plans p ON p.id = a.plan_id WHERE a.country = $1::text ORDER BY p.name, a.name

top N churn-risk accounts grouped by pla.sql: WITH activity AS (SELECT a.id, a.name, p.name AS plan, count(ue.id) FILTER (WHERE ue.occurred_at >= now() - interval '30 days') AS recent_events, (SELECT i.status FROM invoices i WHERE i.account_id = a.id ORDER BY i.issued_at DESC LIMIT 1) AS last_invoice_status FROM accounts a JOIN plans p ON p.id = a.plan_id LEFT JOIN usage_events ue ON ue.account_id = a.id GROUP BY a.id, a.name, p.name), ranked AS (SELECT *, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY plan ORDER BY recent_events ASC, id) AS rn FROM activity) SELECT plan, name, (1.0 / (recent_events + 1))::float8 AS churn_risk, last_invoice_status FROM ranked WHERE rn <= $1::int ORDER BY plan, churn_risk DESC
assumptions: Churn risk is 1 / (usage events in the last 30 days + 1): fewer recent events means higher risk.
